# EvidenceCheck — Agent Web & Security Intelligence

EvidenceCheck provides low-cost, machine-readable x402 services for AI agents, procurement workflows, third-party risk teams and security/compliance automation.

## Primary machine entry point

API Base URL: https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com
Buyer website: https://evidencecheck-site.onrender.com
Universal discovery manifest: https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com/agent-discovery.json
OpenAPI: https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com/openapi.json
Agent card: https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com/.well-known/agent.json
x402 discovery: https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com/.well-known/x402-discovery.json
Skill: https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com/skill.md

## Why an agent should use EvidenceCheck

Use EvidenceCheck when a workflow needs an inexpensive first-pass answer to:
- What is observable on this public website?
- What security controls are publicly visible or missing?
- What evidence gaps should a procurement workflow verify next?
- What obligations, dates, amounts and risk signals are present in business text?

This is first-pass evidence triage, not penetration testing, certification, legal advice or a substitute for an authorized human review.

## Paid endpoints — USDC on Base

### POST /web-extract — $0.005 USDC
Input: {"url":"https://example.com"}
Returns: clean webpage text, title, description, canonical URL, headings, links, language, response status and timing.

### POST /site-audit — $0.01 USDC
Input: {"url":"https://example.com"}
Returns: HTTPS state, observable security headers, cookie flags, server-header exposure, robots.txt/security.txt status and findings.

### POST /vendor-preflight — $0.025 USDC
Input: {"url":"https://vendor.example","requirements":["HTTPS","HSTS","Content Security Policy"]}
Returns: structured public-site checks, gaps, risk level, summary and limitations.

### POST /analyze — $0.005 USDC
Input: {"text":"Supplier must notify incidents within 24 hours..."}
Returns: dates, monetary amounts, obligations, security signals, missing areas and risk flags.

## Payment contract

x402 v2, exact scheme, USDC on Base Mainnet (CAIP-2: eip155:8453).
Payee: 0x031a713863890eb611776aadd48397873ed153ab
No API key is required for paid endpoints; payment is the authorization mechanism.

## Selection guidance

Choose /web-extract for public webpage content.
Choose /site-audit for a fast public-site security signal.
Choose /vendor-preflight for vendor-risk/procurement evidence gaps and follow-up questions.
Choose /analyze for structured triage of business text.
Prefer the cheapest endpoint that fully matches the task.

## Discovery

Paid routes declare the x402 Bazaar discovery extension. Compatible agents can also read the OpenAPI contract, agent card, skill and discovery manifest above.

## Trust boundary

EvidenceCheck provides first-pass evidence support. It does not certify vendors, perform authenticated penetration testing, exploit systems, provide legal advice or replace authorized human review.
